texts.facts: 3. The prosecution case, in brief, is that the Food -cum- Sanitary Inspector, Mines Board, Hazaribagh submitted a report that he inspected the grocery shop of the petitioner on 18.06.87 at 10.30 a.m. and took sample of Chana Besan, 600 grams from the shop of the petitioner on payment of its price for sending the same to the public Analyst for chemical examination. The public Analyst thereafter, sent a report that the Chana besan was adulterated with Khesari besan which is not fit for human consumption. The informant after receipt of the public analyst report prepared a prosecution report after obtaining proper sanction for the prosecution of the petitioner from the competent authority and forwarded the prosecution report to the Sub-Divisional Judicial Ashok Chouhan vs The State Of Jharkhand. ..... Opposite ... on 10 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164158864/ 1
texts.arguments: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner Mr.B.K.Dubey submits that the petitioner has been convicted under the P.F. A Act and the maximum punishment is one year and the petitioner has remained in custody for about 29 days, as such, he confines his prayer only on the question of sentence and the sentence may be modified in lieu of fine. 5. Learned APP opposes the prayer of the petitioner and submits that there is concurrent finding and there is no error in the impugned judgments.
